title: Uniform approximation of continuous compactly supported k-forms by test forms supported in a prescribed open set (mollification)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U, V ⊆ ℝ^P with V open and V ⊆ U, and let φ : ℝ^P → Covector (Eucl P) k be continuous with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ V. Then for every ε > 0 there is a test form η ∈ D^k(U) (TestFormOn U k) with tsupport η ⊆ V and covectorEuclideanNorm(φ(x) − η(x)) ≤ ε for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U V : Set (Eucl P)) (φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k), IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ V → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ η : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ V ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (φ x - (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ≤ ε
